description: This file defines the class StreamConsumerGrainContextAction, which implements IConfigureGrainContext to install stream consumer extensions on grain contexts that observe stream subscriptions within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: StreamConsumerGrainContextAction
classes.description: Implements IConfigureGrainContext to install stream consumer extensions on grain contexts for grains implementing IStreamSubscriptionObserver.

methods.name: StreamConsumerGrainContextAction
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with a stream provider runtime.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the grain context by installing stream consumer extension if the grain instance observes streams.

methods.name: InstallStreamConsumerExtension
methods.description: Installs the stream consumer extension on the grain context for the given observer.
